infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TRAILX records your route with GPS so you can retrace it back to your starting point. Nothing leaves your phone.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: TRAILX keeps recording your route while the screen is locked so your way back is complete.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: TRAILX uses the compass to point you toward your next waypoint.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: TRAILX exchanges encrypted emergency messages with nearby TRAILX devices over Bluetooth.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: TRAILX lets you pick trusted emergency contacts from your address book. Contacts stay on this device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Attach photos to your trek notes.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take photos for your trek notes.
